info.title: PrediNx Budget Planner API
info.description: RESTful API for PrediNx prediction market protocol. Public routes are rate limited per IP or registered API key. Configure RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS, RATE_LIMIT_MAX_REQUESTS, and RATE_LIMIT_STRICT_MAX_REQUESTS; throttled requests return 429 with Retry-After.

servers.description: Local development server (npm run dev, PORT=3001)

200.description: Process and critical dependencies are healthy

503.description: One or more critical dependencies are degraded

get.summary: Dependency health probe under the API prefix

200.description: Process and critical dependencies are healthy

503.description: One or more critical dependencies are degraded

post.summary: Verify a transaction against compliance rules
Activate emergency mode (admin, real on-chain tx)
Deactivate emergency mode (admin, real on-chain tx)

get.summary: List markets (paginated, ordered by ascending id)
get.description: Cancelled (soft-deleted) markets are excluded by default. `status` filters by one or more statuses and combines with `sort`, `order`, `limit` and `offset`; pagination totals always reflect the filtered set. Requesting the `cancelled` status requires admin credentials and is answered with 403 otherwise.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1-100 (default 20; larger values are capped at 100)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Zero-based index of the first market to return (default 0)

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: One or more market statuses to include. Values may be comma-separated (?status=open,settled) and/or repeated (?status=open&status=settled). When omitted, every non-cancelled market is returned. Including "cancelled" requires admin credentials (x-api-key).

200.description: Page of markets with pagination metadata (total, nextOffset, hasMore)

400.description: Invalid pagination, status, sort, or order parameters

403.description: Cancelled markets requested without admin credentials

429.description: Rate limited; see the Retry-After header

post.summary: Create a market (validated; on-chain submission not yet implemented)
post.description: Optional `Idempotency-Key` header (#1466): retries with the same key and payload replay the stored response (`Idempotency-Replayed: true`); a different payload under the same key returns 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional caller-chosen key that makes market creation safe to retry within the TTL window.

outcomes.description: 2-20 unique outcomes, each at most 50 bytes

closeTime.description: Unix seconds, 300 s to 31,536,000 s from now

400.description: Invalid market parameters; error.details lists each offending field

409.description: IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT (key reused with a different payload) or IDEMPOTENCY_REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS (concurrent duplicate)

501.description: On-chain market creation is not yet implemented

get.summary: Export the authenticated user’s market trades as CSV
get.description: Returns only trades for the Stellar account bound to the caller’s USER_API_KEYS entry. The deployment must inject a trade-history source; otherwise the endpoint returns 503.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive ISO date or timestamp (UTC for date-only values)

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Inclusive ISO date or timestamp (UTC for date-only values)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rows in this export page (default 100, maximum 1,000)

400.description: Invalid market id or export filters

401.description: User API key with a bound Stellar address required

429.description: Rate limited; see the Retry-After header

get.description: Returns cancelled markets with the same `limit`/`offset` pagination and `sort`/`order` controls as GET /api/markets. Cancellation keeps every recorded field, so these rows remain linkable.
Newest-first audit entries for every market cancellation and restoration. Optionally filter to one market with `marketId`.

parameters.name: marketId
parameters.description: Only return entries for this market id

post.description: Marks the market with status `cancelled` instead of removing it, preserving the record and its links, and appends an entry to the audit history. Cancelling an already-cancelled market is idempotent and does not duplicate audit entries.

reason.description: Optional reason recorded on the market and in the audit trail

200.description: The cancelled market (status `cancelled`, audit fields set)

post.description: Returns a cancelled market to the status it had before cancellation (recorded in the audit trail) and clears the cancellation fields. Restoring a market that is not cancelled returns 409.

200.description: Simulation result (includes RFC 8594 Deprecation and Sunset headers)

Sunset.description: RFC 8594 / RFC 7231 HTTP-date when the endpoint will be removed

GenericData.description: Generic data wrapper - actual type varies by endpoint

IsoTimestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp - BigInt epoch milliseconds serialized as string

MarketStatus.description: Market lifecycle status. `cancelled` is a soft delete: the record, its data and its audit trail are retained.

MarketSummary.description: One market row, including soft-deleted (cancelled) markets for admins.

totalVolume.description: Total volume in base token units (BigInt serialized as string)

cancelledAt.description: Set only on cancelled markets; ISO timestamp of the soft delete.

cancelledBy.description: Set only on cancelled markets; audit actor that cancelled the market.

cancelReason.description: Set only on cancelled markets; optional reason supplied at cancellation.

MarketAuditEntry.description: One cancellation or restoration record from a market audit trail.

nextOffset.description: Offset for the next page, or null on the last page

prevOffset.description: Offset for the previous page, or null on the first page
